# ankra_cluster_power_schedules (Data Source)

Lists a cluster's scheduled stops and starts. The counterpart of `ankra cluster power-schedules list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_power_schedules" "staging" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `schedules` (Attributes List) Schedules, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `stop` or `start`.
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression of a `cron` schedule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule fires.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the schedule.
- `next_run_at` (String) When the schedule next fires.
- `preserve_state` (Boolean) Whether a stop captures the cluster's state.
- `run_at` (String) When a `once` schedule fires.
- `schedule_kind` (String) `once` or `cron`.
- `stop_mode` (String) How a stop stops the cluster.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone of a `cron` schedule.
